name: Royal Medovik
desc:
A honey cake prepared by Danica herself. Somehow, simply adding "Royal" to its name seems to make it taste even better.
Rumor has it that it was made using a secret recipe only known to the maids of the Zapolyarny Palace, though Danica denies any such thing.

value.text: Restores 30% of Max HP to the selected character and regenerates 790 HP every 5s for 30s.
